integrity: The full exact reconstruction, exceptional observable criterion, and all-rate invisibility example are proved in RESULT.md. Finite exact-rational checks in checker.py are corroboration, not substitute for proof. The cited stochastic-resetting and Lyapunov frameworks are credited to prior work. Originality remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Exactly planar constant-coefficient stable Ornstein-Uhlenbeck motion; complete resets to zero; known two positive Poisson rates; independent strictly positive bath diffusivities; noiseless full stationary covariance matrices. Not a noisy-data stability theorem or higher-dimensional identification theorem.
title: Two-rate covariance tomography and exact rotational blindness in planar resetting
